standard_prerequisites.name: Left and right quantifier rules
standard_prerequisites.statement: Right-exists derives (exists x A(x)) on the right from A(t) on the right; Left-forall derives (forall x A(x)) on the left from A(t) on the left.
standard_prerequisites.use: Item prvEx uses Right-exists on the initial sequent; item prvAll uses Left-forall.

core_obligations: Statement (prop at 1150): (1) A(t) proves exists x A(x); (2) forall x A(x) proves A(t).
Item prvEx (proof from 1157): a one-step derivation applying Right-exists to the initial sequent A(t) sequent A(t), yielding A(t) sequent exists x A(x).
Item prvAll (proof from 1163): a one-step derivation applying Left-forall to the initial sequent A(t) sequent A(t), yielding forall x A(x) sequent A(t).
proof_roadmap: Witness prvEx with the Right-exists one-step derivation.
Witness prvAll with the Left-forall one-step derivation.
Both closed one-step trees establish the two quantifier provability facts.
difficulty_reason: Quantifier provability facts (statement 1150-1156, proof 1157-1171): both one-step derivations carried in span as tagitem branches. H2.
